title: HCP — Revoke Grant — payload
description: The request payload of the HCP 2.0-draft-3 Revoke grant operation (HCP 6.2, 5.4; `DELETE /v2/grants/{grantId}` in HCP 9.2): a Management Client, acting for the Authorizing Principal, ends a grant. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

grantId.description: HCP `grantId` (the `{grantId}` path parameter of HCP 9.2): the grant to revoke.

accessToken.description: The Management Client's HCP access token (HCP 9.3), carried unchanged. HCP's HTTP binding sends it as a Bearer token; this member carries it in the document. The provider validates it exactly as over HTTP and treats it as opaque.

Response.title: HCP — Revoke Grant — response payload
Response.description: The grant is revoked. Carries HCP's `204 No Content`, which has no body, so the payload is the empty object. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.
